1. Slope per day (0.021185543548862953) - This value represents the daily change in the price of Amazon's stock. 2. 30-day moving average (1002.4683308666666) - This value represents the average closing price of Amazon's stock over the past 30 days. It provides a smoother view of the stock's price trend by averaging out the daily fluctuations and can help investors make more informed decisions about entering or exiting positions.

3. Annualized volatility (0.6208157057166519) - This value, also known as standard deviation, measures the amount of day-to-day fluctuations in the stock's price. A higher value indicates that the stock's price is more volatile and experiences larger daily price changes. In this case, Amazon's stock has an annualized volatility of 0.6208, which means its price can be expected to fluctuate by approximately 6.21% on average per year. This level of volatility may make the stock less suitable for investors with a lower risk tolerance but could provide opportunities for more aggressive investors seeking higher returns.
